paraphrased_notes: Redundant-spectrum elimination candidates must have the same frequency and bandwidth.
During Simulation and Propagation controls elimination during intermod input selection, path-spectrum processing and directional total-spectrum processing.
The separate output-only X dB below peak option reduces graph data and does not affect path measurements.
Redundant spectrum reduction can skip spectra that do not affect levels of interest; absolute power and frequency limits are separate controls.
The documentation describes dominant sub-spectrum graph labels and an amplitude containing summed sub-spectra. That statement alone does not establish the semantics of each raw F/P/ID/V/Z record.

interpretation: The mapping of UseSpecReduction to missing raw high-order origin records is supported by paired captures, not inferred solely from help text. Full vendor pages are not distributed.
